title: A filename-only evidence allowlist permitted unreviewed semantic changes
symptom: The review gate allowed whole project and proposal files in the evidence-only child commit.
impact: A child could retain a valid review reference while changing authority, scope, retention, or acceptance fields that the reviewer never inspected.

root_cause.statement: The gate constrained changed paths but not the fields or derived values permitted inside those paths.

solution_options.description: Compare allowed documents with the reviewed parent and permit only reviewer identity and derived review-state transitions.
Permit only a new reviewer evidence file and derive all state outside Git.
tradeoffs: Leaves repository status fields stale or requires a separate projection

checks: Independent reviewer inspected the exact corrective commit
Review gate compared all non-review fields to the parent

prevention: Treat evidence commits as semantic transitions, not filename allowlists
Review the exact immutable parent and reject unrelated child changes

checks: No credential, personal data, customer identity, raw confidential log, or proprietary payload is present.

requirements: Map allowed transitions to the customer's approval model
